title: Why Perplexity AI is the Google killer nobody expected

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if an AI search engine, built on cutting-edge language models, could outperform Google without the same biases or data dependence?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Perplexity AI uses open-source models and real-time processing, enabling faster, more accurate answers with less reliance on historical web data.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if it lacks oversight, it could spread misinformation faster, especially since it's trained on unfiltered, up-to-the-minute content.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We're integrating real-time fact-checking and alignment layers to ensure responses remain truthful and contextually appropriate.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where search is transparent, explainable, and designed to empower users rather than manipulate them.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future may belong to AI that's both powerful and principled — reshaping how we access and trust information.

video_cue: A split-screen showing a user interacting with Perplexity AI on the left and a traditional search engine on the right, with data streams flowing between them.
